manufacturer_or_packer.non_compliance_reason: Rule 6(1)(a) requires the name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer. This panel names EU/UK Responsible Person addresses and no Indian importer. Whether a Responsible Person address discharges the clause is a decision for an officer, not a reading of the label.

commodity_name.non_compliance_reason: No product name is printed on the panel in frame. The descriptor 'face wash gel' occurs only inside the English descriptive prose, and the principal display panel is not in this capture.

net_quantity.non_compliance_reason: Rule 13(2) is satisfied on its face -- a volume below one litre is declared in millilitres. The figure carries the EU estimated sign (e), which is not a declaration form provided for by these Rules; an officer must decide what weight it carries here.

date_of_manufacture_or_packing.raw_text: Batch No.: see below tube/ Gyartasi szam: lasd a tubus hatuljan!/ Chargenr.: zie verpakking.
date_of_manufacture_or_packing.non_compliance_reason: Rule 6(1)(d) third proviso: for packages containing cosmetic products the provisions of the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 apply in place of this sub-clause (R6-1-D source text). The obligation is displaced. No month and year is in frame; the batch reference directs the reader to another part of the pack.

retail_sale_price_mrp.non_compliance_reason: No retail sale price in Indian rupees is printed on the panel in frame. This is a pack prepared for EU/UK retail and carries no MRP by design. datasets/README.md records the standing convention that a foreign-retail pack's missing INR MRP is annotated NOT_APPLICABLE rather than FAIL, and that Rule 25 must not be cited for it: the export limb of the scope argument is marked [SOFT] in rules-corpus/README.md, so this is a project convention and not a sourced exemption.

unit_sale_price.non_compliance_reason: No unit sale price is printed on the panel in frame, and a pack prepared for EU/UK retail carries none. Annotated NOT_APPLICABLE under the same foreign-retail convention as the retail sale price. Rule 6(11) is in any case deliberately unencoded in rules.yaml (rules-corpus/README.md), so no rule id scores this field.

consumer_care_details.non_compliance_reason: Rule 6(1)(n) requires a consumer care cell with name, address, telephone number and email. An email address and a website are in frame; no consumer care cell name and no telephone number are, and the rest of the pack is not in this capture.

notes: Back panel of a Himalaya face wash squeeze tube, 150 ml, at 1080x1080 against a white background, shown with a studio reflection. No reference object is in frame, so the capture is uncalibrated: pdp.is_measurable is false and every height field is null. Rule 26 does not reach it: 150 ml is above the 10 ml threshold. This is a different SKU from the Curcuma tube, not a second view of it -- the two were filed under one directory before DAT-008. No product name is printed on this panel, so the directory name 'neem_turmeric' is taken from the Neem and Turmeric emphasised in the on-pack English description; commodity_name.declared is false accordingly and nothing in the annotation rests on that directory name. A four-language EU-market pack (EN/HU/NL/FR), all Latin script, so it is not tagged multiscript.
